items.title: Uber (UBER) Faces Wrongful Death Lawsuit Over Fatal Uber Eats Delivery
items.summary: A wrongful death lawsuit has been filed against Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:UBER) and a contracted driver following a fatal incident linked to an Uber Eats delivery. The suit alleges negligence, gross negligence, and wrongful death in connection with the delivery trip. The case raises fresh questions about Uber's oversight of gig workers and its responsibility for incidents that occur during app based services.
